summary: Temporary power strips and surge protection for weekend hackathon
description:
Event: Engineering Hackathon (Mar 14-15, 2026). Requesting ~25 temporary power strips with surge protection and cable management for the main conference room and adjacent collaboration spaces. Requirements:
- At least 6 outlets per strip, surge protection rated for office use.
- 15ft cords preferred for flexible placement.
- Labels for asset tracking (temporary checkout).
- Quick safety check by facilities before event start.
Impact: Without additional power distribution we expect device charging contention and potential unsafe daisy-chaining.
Acceptance criteria:
- Power strips delivered to conference room by 18:00 on Mar 13.
- Facilities confirm surge protection and visible labeling.
- Inventory list provided to event lead (Alex Kim).

Action: I'll confirm count by Mar 5.
